event_info.event_description: Analyze for disclosures on global pandemic risks. Look for corporate language discussing widespread impacts like supply chain disruptions, labor shortages, remote work transitions, and fundamental shifts in consumer demand.

holistic_analysis: After a meticulous review of the provided 2023-02-16 STT 10-K excerpt, no sentences explicitly or implicitly address the continuing impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic on the company’s operations, supply chain, labour force, remote-work arrangements or demand patterns.  The text discusses numerous other macro-economic, geopolitical, market-volatility and technology-related risks, yet it never references the pandemic, public-health measures, or disease-related disruptions.  Consequently, there is no basis on which to evaluate pandemic-related risk severity, likelihood, or materiality.  In line with the methodology, when a filing post-dates the triggering event but contains no qualifying disclosure, the overall assessment is that pandemic-specific risk is either deemed immaterial by the issuer or omitted altogether; therefore, the evidentiary score is zero and no micro-scorecards are generated.
